open_issues.title: An 8% Eve can't be detected by design, covered by privacy amplification
open_issues.detail: QBER can stay under the 2.5% warning. No monitor can tell a little eavesdropping from a little noise; privacy amplification (leak subtracted) covers it. Latest: silent keys 6/10 (Eve 8%)
